qa_pairs.question: What special tool is required to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section?
qa_pairs.answer: Special Tool 23 1 050 is required to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: What should be used between the claws and sealing surface to avoid damage when pressing out the shafts?
qa_pairs.answer: To avoid damage on the sealing surface, use a piece of wood, aluminum or similar material between claws and sealing surface.

qa_pairs.question: What pin needs to be driven out from the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
qa_pairs.answer: Pin 10 needs to be driven out from the 3rd/4th gear selector fork.

qa_pairs.question: What is the installation instruction for replacing the pin in the selector fork?
What important precaution must be taken when knocking out the 3rd/4th gear selector rod?
qa_pairs.answer: Important! Lockpin 11 must remain in the selector rod when knocking it out forward.

qa_pairs.question: What must not tilt off during the installation step shown in image 30 23 031?
qa_pairs.answer: The layshaft must not tilt off during this step.

qa_pairs.question: What should be checked on all bearings during installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Check condition of all bearings, replacing if necessary.

qa_pairs.question: How are the 2nd and reverse gears engaged according to the procedure shown?
qa_pairs.answer: Engage 2nd and reverse gears by pushing 1st/2nd and 5th/reverse gear selector rods forward.

qa_pairs.question: What components should be installed together with the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
qa_pairs.answer: Install 3rd/4th gear selector fork and 1st/2nd as well as 5th/reverse gear selector rods with selector forks.

qa_pairs.question: What should be removed from the case rear section according to the final step?
qa_pairs.answer: Remove all detent and locking balls in case rear section.

qa_pairs.question: How should the roller bearings be installed in the case rear section?
qa_pairs.answer: Install roller bearings with large diameter end facing out.

qa_pairs.question: What lubrication is specified for the lockpin and locking lever?
qa_pairs.answer: Lubricate lockpin and locking lever with oil.
